decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not commence until full details for the proposed bank frontage have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The frontage shall not be not be constructed otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the bank hereby permitted commences trade.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the bank shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use of ground floor retail unit known as 316 Bath Road (A1 Retail) to a Bank (A2).
